listing.summary: Research listing. Upstream route: Research/watch identity; do not advertise as established fully native port based on Recomp name. Limits: Interpreter-dominant preview with only two qualified AOT variants; SA1 emulated, no complete human playthrough. Upstream platforms: Windows preview package; prior release also Linux AppImage with x86-64 packaging script. Selected Windows CPU unknown in frozen artifact research; no macOS build. Original data: Own matching 4 MiB headerless SNES ROM; exact SHA256 documented; copier header stripped. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
